name: agent-foundry
description: PAVAN//FOUNDRY — an agentic operating system disguised as a portfolio.

scripts.assay: node --experimental-strip-types tools/collect-evidence.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types tools/collect-sealed.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types tools/verify-evidence.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types tools/record-standings.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types tools/assay-summary.ts
scripts.ci:local: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && node -e "for(const f of require('fs').readdirSync('tools'))if(f.endsWith('.mjs'))require('child_process').execFileSync(process.execPath,['--check','tools/'+f])" && pnpm build
